design_description: A black and metallic-gold jersey dominated by an all-over marble/cracked-stone pattern. Irregular gold veins spread organically across the black base, giving the kit a rich, high-contrast appearance. Gold detailing continues through the collar, sleeve cuffs and side panels, keeping the palette consistent and framing the busier marble graphic. The back maintains the same all-over pattern with a large gold player name and number. Overall, it's a bold, luxurious design, with the black-and-gold marble effect serving as the main visual identity.
